server128.label: CS:GO bhop server
server128.summary: the approved R14 bhop server: AA 100 · 128 Hz · autohop · no stamina, no takeoff clamp · crouch with Ctrl or C
server128.controls:
WASD run · mouse look · hold Space to keep hopping (or scroll) · Ctrl or C crouches, on the ground and in the air
Air strafe: release W, hold A or D and turn the mouse the same way · release keys to coast

server128_aa1000.label: Bhop server AA 1000
server128_aa1000.summary: the same bhop server at AA 1000 · 128 Hz · a configured comparison some servers run, not universal CS
server128_aa1000.controls:
WASD run · mouse look · hold Space to keep hopping (or scroll) · Ctrl or C crouches
Air strafe: release W, hold A or D and turn the mouse the same way · release keys to coast

quake3_inspired128.label: Quake III-inspired
quake3_inspired128.jump: P autohop: hold Space (wheel works too)
quake3_inspired128.summary: P: Quake III's declared accel 10 · AA 1 · friction 6 · stopspeed 100 · 320 u/s · gravity 800 · jump 270, projected to the full 320 u wish instead of Source's 30 u cap · 128 Hz · Source hull and collision · no Quake command rounding or contacts, not Quake or CPMA
quake3_inspired128.controls:
WASD run (320 u/s) · mouse look · hold Space to keep hopping (or scroll)
In the air: hold W with A or D and turn the mouse gently the same way · let go of every key to coast on your line

r13_original120.label: R13 Overflow (unchanged)
r13_original120.summary: the original R13 runner and camera · 120 Hz · keys bend the flight · its own capsule body, so crouch passages may not fit
r13_original120.controls:
WASD run · mouse look · hold Space to keep hopping
In the air keys bend your flight where they point · no keys keeps your line · S brakes

tether-yard.theme: Hold, swing and release across the transfer yard
tether-yard.key_hint: · Hold LMB at a ring; release to coast
tether-yard.instructions: EXPERIMENTAL grapple course. Aim at a marked ring, hold LMB to attach, RMB reels, release LMB to coast. Jump into a transfer, then aim at the next ring. Slide and wall jump are off.

through-line.name: Through Line
through-line.theme: Build speed, rise through the fork, land running
through-line.key_hint: · Forward through the raised fork at 230+ u/s
through-line.instructions: EXPERIMENTAL · bhop down First Run. Cross the tall orange fork forward at 230+ u/s: horizontal speed carries unchanged; more speed gives more lift. Air-strafe onto Second Run's raised cream court, then keep moving to its far finish. One launch per attempt; R resets. Dotted arcs are 250 / 500 u/s examples, not steering assistance.
